parts.name: TimePickerRoot
parts.description: Holds the picker's time and open state and shares them, with `min`, `max`, `locale`, `granularity`, the steps and the rest, with the parts inside it. Renders no element.

props.name: value
props.description: The time, a `Temporal.PlainTime`. Pass it with `onValueChange` to control the picker; `null` is controlled and empty, and leaving it out (or `undefined`) lets the picker hold its own value. It may be read from an answer that is loading or guessed over; one that fails is left to the app's `errored` region.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The time at first, when the picker isn't controlled. A form reset puts it back.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the time for each choice in the popup and each complete time typed in the field, and with `undefined` when the field becomes incomplete. It is called in a change of its own, so it may save without holding the picker.

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the popup is open. Pass it with `onOpenChange` to control it. Escape and a press outside can't be refused: a popup kept open is shown again.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Whether the popup is open at first, when it isn't controlled.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called after the popup opens or closes, in a change of its own.

props.name: min
props.description: The earliest valid time. Options before it are disabled, a choice is clamped to it, and an earlier time typed in the field marks it invalid (`rangeUnderflow`).

props.name: max
props.description: The latest valid time. Options after it are disabled, a choice is clamped to it, and a later time typed in the field marks it invalid (`rangeOverflow`).

props.name: locale
props.description: The locale of the field's segments and the options' text: digits, day period names and hour cycle.

props.name: granularity
props.description: The smallest unit: `"hour"`, `"minute"` or `"second"`. TimePickerSeconds renders only at `"second"`, TimePickerMinutes not at `"hour"`.

props.name: hourCycle
props.description: `12` or `24` overrides the locale's hour cycle; TimePickerDayPeriod renders only in 12-hour time.

props.name: minuteStep
props.description: Minutes between the minute column's options. It shapes the list, not the value: a time typed off the step is valid and selects no minute.

props.name: secondStep
props.description: Seconds between the second column's options.

props.name: placeholderValue
props.default: the time the popup opened at (for the field: midnight)
props.description: What a choice in a column starts from while there is no value (and what an empty segment steps from). Without it, a choice starts from the time the popup opened at.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the picker can't be changed: the field is disabled and the trigger is a disabled button. Also true inside a disabled FieldRoot.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Whether the field can be focused but not changed. The trigger is disabled, so the popup doesn't open.

props.name: required
props.description: Whether a time is needed for the form to be valid.

props.name: name
props.description: The name the field's hidden input submits the time under (`13:45`, or `13:45:00` with `granularity="second"`). Taken from an enclosing FieldRoot when not given.

props.name: form
props.description: The id of a `<form>` the hidden input belongs to, when the picker isn't inside it.

props.name: invalid
props.description: For a composition that keeps the Field to itself (Time Range Picker): marks the field and every segment invalid. Given, it wins over an enclosing FieldRoot's state; a time outside `min`/`max` is invalid either way.

props.name: describedBy
props.description: For a composition: the ids each segment's `aria-describedby` gets (a Field's description and error). Given, it wins over an enclosing FieldRoot's.

props.name: onIncompleteChange
props.description: For a composition: called with whether the field is partly filled, whenever that changes.

parts.name: TimePickerField
parts.description: The field: a TimeFieldRoot given the picker's value, bounds, locale, name and state, so it is a `role="group"` named by its `aria-label`, `aria-labelledby` or an enclosing FieldLabel. Inside it go Time Field's own parts (TimeFieldInput and a TimeFieldSegment per entry of `use timeField`'s `segments`) and usually the trigger. Its hidden `<input type="time">` is the only one the picker submits.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: What an empty segment's `aria-valuetext` says, in the app's language.

props.name: incompleteMessage
props.description: The validation message while some segments are filled and others not.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the picker is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while one of the field's segments has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the time is outside `min`/`max`, or the FieldRoot around it is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the picker is read-only.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when the picker is required.

parts.name: TimePickerTrigger
parts.description: The button that opens and closes the popup, through the browser's `popovertarget`. `aria-haspopup="dialog"`; named "Choose time" unless given `aria-label`. Disabled while the picker is disabled or read-only.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the picker is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-popup-open
dataAttributes.description: Present while the popup is open.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the picker is read-only.

parts.name: TimePickerPopup
parts.description: The popup: a `popover="auto"` element placed against the trigger with CSS anchor positioning, `role="dialog"`, named "Choose time" unless given `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`. It closes on Escape, a press outside, Enter on an option, and focus leaving it. Style it with `:popover-open` and `@starting-style`, not a `display` rule.

props.name: side
props.description: Which side of the trigger it sits on; the browser flips it when it doesn't fit.

props.name: align
props.default: "end", under a trigger at the field's end
props.description: Which edge of the trigger it lines up with.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Gap between trigger and popup, in pixels.

props.name: alignOffset
props.description: Shift along the trigger's edge, in pixels.

dataAttributes.name: data-side
dataAttributes.description: The side of the trigger the popup is on, after any flip.

parts.name: TimePickerHours
parts.description: The hours column, a listbox: 0–23, or in 12-hour time the 12 hours of the value's day period. Opening scrolls it to the selected hour and focuses it. Its options are `role="option"` elements with `data-selected` and `data-disabled`, styled through the column. Named "Hours" unless given `aria-label`.

props.name: gridColumns
props.description: Number of options per row in a CSS grid. Arrow keys move within the grid and Tab moves between units.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the picker is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-unit
dataAttributes.description: `hour`.

parts.name: TimePickerMinutes
parts.description: The minutes column, a listbox of the minutes every `minuteStep`. Renders nothing with `granularity="hour"`. Named "Minutes" unless given `aria-label`.

props.name: gridColumns
props.description: Number of options per row in a CSS grid. Arrow keys move within the grid and Tab moves between units.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the picker is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-unit
dataAttributes.description: `minute`.

parts.name: TimePickerSeconds
parts.description: The seconds column, a listbox of the seconds every `secondStep`. Renders nothing unless `granularity="second"`. Named "Seconds" unless given `aria-label`.

props.name: gridColumns
props.description: Number of options per row in a CSS grid. Arrow keys move within the grid and Tab moves between units.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the picker is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-unit
dataAttributes.description: `second`.

parts.name: TimePickerDayPeriod
parts.description: The AM/PM column, in the locale's words. Renders nothing in 24-hour time. Choosing one keeps the hour on the clock face (9:30 AM becomes 9:30 PM). Named "AM/PM" unless given `aria-label`.

props.name: gridColumns
props.description: Number of options per row in a CSS grid. Arrow keys move within the grid and Tab moves between units.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the picker is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-unit
dataAttributes.description: `dayPeriod`.

parts.name: TimePickerOptions
parts.description: The other popup design: one listbox of whole times every `interval` minutes from midnight (09:00, 09:30 …), those outside `min` and `max` disabled. Any choice (a click, Enter or Space) sets the whole time and closes the popup. Named "Times" unless given `aria-label`.

props.name: interval
props.description: Minutes between the options.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the picker is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: `vertical`.

dataAttributes.name: data-target
dataAttributes.description: The option it opens on when none is selected: the one nearest the time it starts from.
